findings.notes: Two-head private function is well-formed. First head uses Elixir's cross-argument variable-equality pattern (%Attachment{instance_id: instance_id}, instance_id) -- idiomatic and correct; no guard needed. Pin-match head first, catch-all (%Attachment{}, _instance_id) second. Consistent with check_scan_status_clean/1's shape in the same module.

Chain order matches design doc §4: get/2 → check_instance_match → check_scan_status_clean → blob read. Inserting check_instance_match before check_scan_status_clean is correct and required: cross-instance denial must not reveal scan_status (side-channel). All arms use {:ok, value} and :ok shapes. with short-circuits at check_instance_match returning {:error, :not_found} before the blob Repo.get -- 1 round-trip cost preserved (INV-5).

Syntactically valid named-parameter form. Return union {:error, :invalid_id | :not_found | :content_missing | :not_available} matches all actual return paths: get/2 yields :invalid_id and :not_found, check_instance_match yields :not_found, check_scan_status_clean yields :not_available, blob miss yields :content_missing. No omissions.
Diff strictly limited to attachments.ex, instances.ex, and attachments_test.exs. No unrelated function changes. No abstractions or framework machinery introduced.
Zero new processes, supervisors, or spawns. Pure function-level change throughout.

:not_found is the unified denial atom for all denial paths (cross-tenant, cross-instance, never-issued, malformed UUID) -- consistent with AC5/AC6/INV-5. Tenant scope unchanged (prefix-threaded through get/2). Implementation matches design doc iss0785-attachment-instance-check.md exactly: signature, chain order, call site update, dead-branch retention decision (§5b).

Both comments are accurate. First arm comment ('defense-in-depth: instance check now handled upstream in get_content/3') correctly describes changed semantics. Second arm comment correctly identifies it as dead after ISS-0785 and states why it is retained. No misleading framing.

Test file updates only update existing call sites to the new arity. No new test covers the cross-instance denial path (get_content(id, other_instance_id, opts) -> {:error, :not_found}). This is TEST-DESIGNER's responsibility and does not block PASS here, but TEST-DESIGNER must add a test for the cross-instance case.

result.summary: PASS. All seven gate checks clear. One non-blocking note forwarded to TEST-DESIGNER: a new test for the cross-instance denial path (wrong instance_id -> {:error, :not_found}) is absent and must be added.
